_comment: Retired corpus repositories. See docs/corpus-order.md and the convention this reuses: safe-app-store-public/docs/conventions/tombstones.md. 'ended' is a closed enum and each shape has a required forward; refresh.py refuses a record that omits it.

willow-grove.reason: The grove was rebuilt as willows-grove, which carries the Heimdallr identity the old repo hosted. The identity was never retired -- only the repo and the registry id. Source: github/archive/RETIRE-grove-2026-08-27.md, which records the local move to ~/github-archive-grove-2026-08-27/willow-grove, the archival of both remotes, and the removal of the safe-app-willow-grove registry id.
carried: 693 corpus claims remain under the repository name 'willow-grove', extracted as 'safe-app-willow-grove'. They describe the retired tree and are NOT claims about willows-grove, which has never been extracted and holds 0 claims.

willow.reason: The charter repo. Its content did not go to one place: the charter documents (CONSTITUTION.md, PROTECTED_AGENTS.md, PROTECTED_PERSONS.md, AGENT_SERVICES.md) and the governance/ tree were relocated 2026-08-28 to willows-grove/governance/, the watchman's seat; fleet.json had already gone to $WILLOW_HOME/fleet.json, mem_ratify/ to willow-mcp, seed/ to both. willows-grove is named as successor because it now holds the charter itself. Archive: ~/github-archive-willow-2026-08-27/willow. Both remotes (rudi193-cmd/Willow, willow-memory/Willow) are archived.
carried: 134 corpus claims remain under repository 'willow', pinned at willow@ba332ae - 100 of them CONSTITUTION.md, 28 PROTECTED_AGENTS.md. They describe the archived tree. willows-grove has never been extracted and holds 0 claims, so the charter's text is queryable only under the retired name until the successor is read.

envelopes/ deliberately stayed in the archive: its own MOVED.md records the default-path role moving to $WILLOW_HOME/constitutional/, and the archived pre-approved.json / syscall-table.json are the operator's real grants as of 2026-07-22 / 2026-07-06, kept as historical record.
design/ (2.8 MB), tools/, notes/ and soil/ were not relocated and remain archive-only.

FLEET_PLACEMENT_DRAFT.md carries two open items overtaken by the archival - a present-tense claim that the charter is on disk at willow-memory/willow (§490), and 'ratify transfer' as outstanding (§613). Left for the operator: amending a draft's open items is a ratification, not a path repair.

willow-2.0.reason: The fleet-dev monolith. Archived on GitHub 2026-08-19 and kept locally at ~/github-archive-greenfield-2026-08-10/archive/legacy-flat-2026-08-10/willow-2.0 -- clean, 52,320 files, extracted 2026-08-30. Its platform half became willow-mcp; several tools did not travel and have no successor yet, notably apps/ratatosk (a capability-gated phone + desktop runtime: doctor/listen/explain/panic, termux boot scripts, a systemd listener) and scripts/gitsync/gitsync-loop.py (the whole-tree sync on a timer that the 2026-07-20 box map assumed and which no longer runs). Recorded so the code stays findable: the repo ended, the tools did not necessarily end with it.
